svg.text: #603 Enterprise E-Commerce AI: 1,500 QPS Visual Search + 82/18 Shopping Agent + Nightly Catalog
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 24ms Visual+Hybrid Search (8× L40S) · 200 QPS Shopping Assistant (4× L40S + 6× H200) · 2M SKUs/Night Free
1. Three-Tier Retail AI Workload Separation
Tier 1: 1,500 QPS Visual & Hybrid Search Bar (P95 SLA <= 30ms)
• SigLIP-SO400M + BGE-M3 (512d INT8 HNSW) + TEI cu_seqlens Top-50 Reranker
• Fleet: 8× L40S-48GB ($7,600/mo) · P95 Latency: 24.0ms · +8.4% Search GMV Conversion!
Tier 2: 200 QPS Conversational Shopping & Returns Agent (82/18 Cascade)
• 82% Order/Size/Policy Queries → Distilled 8B-FP8 on 4× L40S (TTFT 95ms)
• 18% Multi-Item Comparison + OPA Refund Gate → 72B-FP8 on 6× H200 ($20,400/mo)
Tier 3: 2M SKUs/Day Multimodal Catalog Tagging & 12-Language SEO
• Runs 00:00–07:00 overnight on the SAME 12× L40S + 6× H200 online fleet!
• Processes 600M tokens/night via Ray Data + XGrammar Taxonomy at $0 Extra GPU CapEx!
2. Real-Time Price/Stock Injection & Black Friday Scaling
Never Index Dynamic Price or Inventory Count Inside Vector Embeddings!
• Re-embedding 100M SKUs every time stock or flash-sale price changes is impossible
• Keep static visual/semantic embeddings in HNSW; join live Redis price/stock by SKU_ID
in 1.5ms AFTER Top-50 retrieval and BEFORE feeding the Shopping LLM
• Eliminates 100% of out-of-stock recommendations and stale-price hallucinations
Global Retail Platform TCO (1,500 Search QPS + 200 Chat QPS + 2M SKUs)
• Naive Siloed LLM Search + All-70B Chat + Cloud Batch API: $428,000/month
• Unified Retail AI Fleet: 12× L40S ($11.4k) + 6× H200 ($20.4k) + 80GB Vector DB ($0.5k)
= $32,300/month (-92.5% Cost Reduction · Saves $4.75M/year!)
• Black Friday 5x Surge: Overflow 18% complex chat to Cloud PAYGO while L1 cache absorbs 68%
3. Retail AI Golden Architecture Rule
• Never route top-of-page search bar traffic (1,500 QPS, <30ms SLA) to an autoregressive LLM!
• Serve the search bar with SigLIP + BGE-M3 + TEI Cross-Encoder (24ms), and trigger conversational LLMs only on explicit shopping assistant clicks.
